_comment: Tuning for the TikTok carousel pipeline. Everything the template needs that
is NOT per-post lives here, so a look change is a config edit, never a code
edit. See README.md.
font: file in fonts/. Run `node slideshow.mjs fonts` to fetch
the candidates and `python render.py --font-sample` to compare them.
backgrounds.*: subfolders of backgrounds/ (gitignored - you
fill them). `player` carries the hook and the numbered items, `stadium`
carries the CTA. Split so a stadium wide-shot never lands on slide 1, where
a face is doing the stopping work.
afterItem: the app mention goes AFTER this many numbered items, not at
the end. With itemCount 5 and afterItem 4 the carousel reads
hook, 1, 2, 3, 4, app, 5 - so the plug lands while people are still
swiping and the last slide is content, not an ad. Set it to itemCount to
put the CTA last instead.
cta.text: Tip: start using the Drillr app to get daily stretches and drills made for your position
_overlays: Two of them, positioned off the reference promo slide rather than by eye:
the phone shot large on the right, the store listing small and low on the
left. xPct/yPct are the CENTRE of each, as fractions of the frame.
Order matters - later entries paste on top.

_note: app-home.jpg keeps its own black margin around the device, so these
numbers place the OUTER rectangle where the reference has it and the
phone lands inside. radiusPct is the device's own corner radius plus
that margin, which keeps the rounding concentric with the screen.

_comment: repeatHooks: may a hook be used more than once?
true (current) - yes. The account already does it: '5 things that will kill
your football career' ran on 2026-05-30 and again on 2026-06-16 with a
different set of items. Previous hooks are still shown to the model, as
context rather than as a ban, so it can reuse one deliberately or vary away
from it. `import` queues a repeat and notes it instead of skipping it.
false - the original behaviour. The prompt forbids repeating an angle or
writing a near-synonym of one, and `import` silently drops any draft whose
hook is already in the queue. Flip this one value to get all of that back;
nothing else needs editing.
OFF until the app clears TikTok's audit - see README 'Turning on auto-post'.
urlPrefix must be a domain verified in the TikTok developer portal;
PULL_FROM_URL rejects anything else, including Firebase Storage URLs.
privacyLevel stays SELF_ONLY while unaudited: TikTok forces private on
unaudited clients anyway, and asking for PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE just fails.
